evidence.exclusions: The two Pro Settings captures have the obsolete narrow fallback banner; the current Pro Max/iPad Settings captures supersede that defect. English source text versus requested German native text, real native safe areas, 3x/2x raster scales and CoreText rasterization are not source-fidelity failures. positiveChecks: The supplied normal-size primary shell/profile/chat/settings capture matrix preserves the original visual identity, density, colors, vectors and main structure.
Pro Max account bar and profile fit the width and remain centered; primary phone shell backgrounds fill the screen without unrelated gray bands.
Current Pro Max/iPad Settings fallback banner fills its account card width.
The supplied accessibility Home capture keeps the heading, list actions, conversation names and bottom labels readable without additional visible clipping beyond the known fixed-glyph/avatar issue.

findings.title: Large Dynamic Type clips the account @ glyph inside its fixed icon box
findings.evidence: original-ui-promax-accessibility-home.png visibly shows a severed @ in the account tools. Avatar fallback initials and unread numerals also scale inside fixed visual geometry.
findings.action: Use a non-scaling font for fixed decorative glyph/avatar geometry, retain accessible labels, and capture the same large Home state after the fix.
findings.confirmationStatus: Final repository Home image original-ui-0.2.1-iphone-promax-accessibility-large-dark-home.png shows complete @, fixed-size avatar initials and fixed-size DC rail initials. NativeOriginalShellViews.swift:47 now uses OriginalYapper.fixedFont(16,numericWeight:700).

findings.title: Profile footer actions occupy the bottom system safe-area inset
findings.evidence: Pro and Pro Max own-profile captures place the Edit control only about17pt above the physical bottom. NativeProfileView ignores the bottom safe area and profileBody reserves only16pt beneath its final control. The 34pt phone bottom inset is therefore not applied to interactive content.
findings.action: Reserve the actual bottom safe inset for profile interactive content while extending the original card background to the screen edge. Check own Edit and friend composer/send with normal and large Dynamic Type.
findings.confirmationStatus: Current30 default matrix and large ProfileB11EF6C4-78C3-40DD-8484-B764DEBF31C8.png show the Edit footer above the real bottom inset while the background extends to the edge.

findings.title: Several primary controls retain source visual sizes without the promised native44pt hit regions
findings.evidence: Account popover edit is30x30 and menu rows are33.6pt high; own-profile close/edit are40pt; Settings navigation and dismiss are40pt high, and account-row Edit is36pt. These plain buttons have no44pt interaction shape expansion. The normal screenshots correctly preserve the small visible geometry, so the fix belongs to hit regions rather than artwork size.
findings.action: Expand native interaction regions to at least44x44pt without changing visible source geometry. Keep adjacent hit regions unambiguous; where source rows are contiguous, expose an equivalent accessible native action rather than overlapping multiple invisible buttons.
findings.confirmationStatus: Reviewed source applies expanded interaction shapes to the reported primary controls. Static screenshots confirm unchanged visible geometry. A physical-device or boundary-coordinate routing audit was not performed.

findings.title: Scaled Menu and Account text is placed in unscaled fixed-height line boxes
findings.evidence: OriginalYapper.uiFont scales through UIFontMetrics, but the account popover fixes20pt name and13pt handle to24/18.2pt heights. Settings accountRow fixes11pt labels and15pt values to15.4/21pt. At the supplied accessibility scaling, line metrics outgrow those heights and risk truncation or overlap. No supplied large Menu/Settings capture verifies these states.
findings.action: Retain exact default-size minimum heights while allowing scaled text to grow. Add vertical overflow handling for the account popover and capture large Menu, expanded status menu, Settings and Profile on a phone.
findings.confirmationStatus: Menu9764775B-42EA-4A45-90CA-9989E443F230.png shows readable name/handle and growing wrapped menu rows. Settings61BB55D2-946F-49E0-813A-01C582CD7A66.png shows complete account labels/values and naturally wrapped privacy selection. The expanded presence menu overflow fallback was not captured.

minorSourceObservation.title: Sidebar title is16pt in native versus15px/700 in the actual React runtime
minorSourceObservation.action: Use the recorded15pt default-size value in the next source-fidelity pass; rasterization differences do not explain a numeric size mismatch.

notApplicable: Mandatory SF typography, system Form/List/TabView chrome or new large-title navigation, which conflict with the binding exact-original brief.

confirmation.status: Bounded default/source/AX-large confirmation complete, including final rail-initial Home confirmation; no production edits by reviewer.

confirmation.defaultResult: No new primary-screen visual issue found in the bounded confirmation. Profile footer clears the bottom inset while card background reaches the edge. Normal fit/centering/fill and full-width Settings banners hold across the matrix.
confirmation.largeEvidence: work/ios-native/original-ui-large-captures/manifest.json: actual AX-large dark Pro Max five-surface run. Final Home-only confirmation inspected the repository Home PNG after the decorative rail-initial correction; parent reports original-ui-large-final.xcresult passed all five surfaces. largeObservations.observation: Final screenshot confirms a complete account @, fixed-size avatar initials and fixed-size DC rail initials. Heading, list actions, conversation names and bottom-navigation labels remain readable.
Name and handle are readable without line-box clipping. Long localized menu rows wrap and grow inside the card. No expanded presence selector captured.
Profile fits, identity and sections are readable, and Edit control stays above the bottom inset.
Author/date/message text is readable; body and introductory text wrap naturally. Header actions and composer remain visible.

Account label/value lines no longer use clipped fixed-height boxes. Name/handle and account edit actions fit. Privacy text grows below the fold in its ScrollView; horizontal settings navigation remains a horizontal strip.
